confusion_sources.description: RESEARCH_PLAN_PHASE2_20260813.md v1.0.0 was never committed to git. It exists only as an untracked file in data/coordination/, not referenced by ACTIVE_SPRINT.json or any tracked config. This means the plan was invisible to git-based review and CI.
confusion_sources.impact: High - the plan's existence and R13-R38 redefinitions were unknown until the file inventory was manually performed.
confusion_sources.resolution: Plan was archived to docs/archive/strategy/2026-08-14/ with supersession note.

confusion_sources.description: RESEARCH_PLAN_PHASE2_20260813.md redefined gaps R13-R38 with completely different topics than RESEARCH_PLAN_PHASE1_4_20260813.md v3.1.0. Example collisions: R13=this-plan=Plugin Architecture vs Phase2=Fleet Health Dashboard; R14=this-plan=Streaming Heartbeat (resolved) vs Phase2=Subagent Pair-Execution Chains; R30=this-plan=5-way CB spike vs Phase2=same topic (agreement).
confusion_sources.impact: Critical - dev sprint depends on this plan's gap definitions; same numbers mean different things.
confusion_sources.resolution: Renumbered 17 divergent Phase2-topic reports R13-R38 → R39-R56 (kept R30). Original Phase1-4 topics for R13,R14b,R16,R17,R18,R19,R23,R24,R25,R26,R31,R33,R34,R35,R37,R38 remain OUTSTANDING (not researched).

confusion_sources.description: @researcher executed research per an untracked plan (Phase2) that redefined gap numbers. The researcher was likely working from the Phase2 plan without knowledge that this plan conflicted with the authoritative Phase1-4 plan. The collision was only discovered during the 2026-08-14 reconciliation by @kali.
confusion_sources.impact: High - explains why 18 research reports follow different topics than the gap catalog.
confusion_sources.resolution: Reconciliation notes added to plan v3.2.0, TASK_REGISTRY, and HMC. Researcher's 17 reports renumbered R39-R56.

confusion_sources.description: During the rename script execution on 2026-08-14, the script removed R38_LAZY_LOADING_20260813.md but the destination R56_LAZY_LOADING_20260813.md was not created (likely a script bug or filesystem issue). The file was never git-tracked, so it cannot be recovered from version control. A reconstructed stub was created preserving only metadata.
confusion_sources.impact: Medium - one report's content is lost; the task is recorded as completed in TASK_REGISTRY but the artifact is missing.
confusion_sources.resolution: Reconstructed stub R56_LAZY_LOADING_20260813.md created with clear LOST marker; re-research required. TASK_REGISTRY notes flag this.

confusion_sources.description: Both the Phase1-4 plan and the Phase2 plan define R30 as the 5-way circuit breaker spike benchmark. This is the ONLY gap number that agrees between the two plans. @researcher's R30_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_BENCHMARK resolves it for both.
confusion_sources.impact: Positive - provides a single agreed-upon reference point.
confusion_sources.resolution: R30 kept as R30 in both plans; marked RESOLVED in v3.2.0.
